name: What is the typical timeline for purchasing a new construction home in Miami?

mainEntity.name: What is the typical timeline for purchasing a new construction home in Miami?

acceptedAnswer.text: The timeline for purchasing a new construction home in Miami can vary significantly. If the home is already built (spec home), the process might be similar to an existing home, taking 30-60 days to close once financing is secured. For homes built from the ground up, the construction phase can range from 6 to 18 months or more, depending on the builder, complexity, and supply chain. It's crucial to understand the builder's estimated completion date and any potential delays. Working with a real estate agent specializing in new construction, like Kelby Contreras, can help manage expectations and track progress effectively.
acceptedAnswer.description: The timeline for new construction homes in Miami varies from 30-60 days for completed homes to 6-18 months or more for ground-up builds, depending on builder and complexity.
